items.excerpt: A coalition convened by Kathleen Kennedy and AFI's Susan Ruskin published 'Human Generative Workflows,' a framework that separates AI-assisted craft steps (color grading assists, upscaling, markerless mocap) from prompted synthetic performance, and argues for a shared vocabulary of authorship in production.

Autodesk Flow Studio's new 3D Editor + Canvas combines interactive 3D scene construction with generative 2D video models, so AI shots can be blocked, staged and re-framed like a real set instead of re-rolled from prompts.

LA studio Impossible Objects is running AI models locally on HP ZGX Nano desktops, folding artist-driven generative workflows in alongside traditional VFX tools without shipping client plates to the cloud.

Abigail Hing Wen's hybrid animated/live-action short 'The Vale - Origins' tells a story about an AI-powered virtual sanctuary built from a child's drawings — and was deliberately made without generative AI.

Drew Geraci stress-tests Seedance 2.5 with long-form, shot-designed prompts in a new MZed module on ethical AI video, showing how directing language (lens, blocking, continuity) changes generated output.
Filmmaking YouTubers including Matti Haapoja and Sam Kolder are facing audience revolt for promoting Higgsfield and Seedance 2.5, a signal of how the creative audience is policing AI sponsorship.

Roger Avary's 'Paradise Lost' and Alex Proyas' 'Heaven' — both produced with Ex Machina Studios' proprietary AI pipeline — have landed U.S. theatrical commitments for 2027, a first real wide-release test for AI-made features.
SP Studios rebuilt its LED volume workflow around Brompton Hydra, changing how in-camera VFX shots are lit, calibrated and captured on set.
Animaze Montreal's 2026 edition (Sept 17-19) adds a first-ever AI Animation Forum to its programming, putting generative pipelines on the main stage of a legacy animation festival.
Curious Refuge walks through Apple's new photoreal personal-avatar cloning and what near-perfect digital doubles mean for performance capture and on-camera talent in AI filmmaking.

A 30-character stress test of Seedance 2.5 measuring how well the model holds character identity across shots — the consistency problem that decides whether generative video can carry a narrative scene.
Curious Refuge tests a free AI video generator against paid tools, benchmarking where no-cost models now land for indie filmmaker shot generation.

WildBrain is buying Personality AI, the generative-AI company behind conversational 'Hey Peppa Pig' characters, moving real-time AI character performance into a major kids-animation studio's production and IP pipeline.

Production designer Brandon Tonner-Connolly breaks down a hand-painted glass matte shot on 'Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma' — an in-camera answer to effects work that would default to digital or generative today.
